Impeccable doctor: <WS>

needs a command (2):
  product-schema-legacy  [PRODUCT.md]
    PRODUCT.md has no schema stamp and none of the sections the current record adds (Positioning, Operating Context, Evidence on Hand, Product Principles), so it predates this version of the product record.
    → Offer `init`, which preserves confirmed answers and fills the gaps by interview. Do not rewrite the file from inference.
  design-sidecar-schema-outdated  [DESIGN.json]
    DESIGN.json is schemaVersion 1; the current sidecar is 2. Token primitives moved to the DESIGN.md frontmatter, so the old shape carries values that are now read from two places.
    → Offer `document` to regenerate the sidecar. It reads the existing DESIGN.md, so no interview is needed.

worth saying (9):
  product-deprecated-register  [PRODUCT.md]
    PRODUCT.md still carries a `## Register` section. v4 replaced the brand/product register axis with the four visitor modes (Persuade, Operate, Read, Experience), which are chosen per surface and persisted in that surface's brief. Nothing reads `## Register` any more.
    → Treat `## Register` as absent for every decision this session. Offer to delete the section; do not let its value influence the work either way.
  design-sidecar-stale  [DESIGN.json]
    DESIGN.md was edited after DESIGN.json was generated, so the sidecar's ramps, shadows, motion tokens, and component snippets may contradict it.
    → Offer `document` to refresh the sidecar, preserving DESIGN.md.
  design-md-coverage  [DESIGN.md]
    DESIGN.md has no components section. Agents generating new screens get no normative guidance for those, and the live design panel renders generic approximations in their place.
    → Ask whether the section never applied or was never written. `document` fills it from the code if the project has the answer in its CSS.
  config-unknown-keys  [.impeccable/config.json]
    .impeccable/config.json has top-level key(s) nothing reads: `theme`. Recognized keys are `hook`, `detector`, `updateCheck`, `stalenessCheck`, `projectRoots`, `buildPath`, `$schema`, `version`.
    → Report the exact keys to the user. A near-miss of a real key is a setting that has never applied.
  config-invalid-build-path  [.impeccable/config.json]
    .impeccable/config.json sets `buildPath` to "fast", which nothing reads. The values are `comp` and `code`.
    → Report the value. An unread `buildPath` does not fall back to the other path; it falls back to the default, so a project meaning `code` has been building comp-led.
  config-unknown-detector-keys  [.impeccable/config.json]
    .impeccable/config.json has `detector` key(s) nothing reads: `mode`. Recognized keys are `ignoreRules`, `ignoreFiles`, `ignoreValues`, `designSystem`, `extensions`.
    → Report the exact keys. `ignoreRule` for `ignoreRules` is the common one, and it silences nothing.
  detector-ignore-rules-unknown  [.impeccable/config.json]
    .impeccable/config.json ignores rule id(s) the detector does not have: `not-a-real-rule`. Either the rule was renamed or removed, or the id was mistyped and has never suppressed anything.
    → Report the exact ids. Removing them is safe; keeping a dead ignore hides that the rule is gone.
  detector-ignore-files-missing  [.impeccable/config.json]
    .impeccable/config.json ignores file path(s) that no longer exist: `src/vendor/missing.css`.
    → Ask whether the file moved (repoint the entry) or was deleted (drop it). A stale entry silently stops covering the file that replaced it.
  surface-brief-orphaned  [.impeccable/surfaces/src-old-astro.md]
    1 persisted surface brief(s) name a primary target that no longer exists: .impeccable/surfaces/src-old-astro.md → src/old.astro.
    → Ask whether the surface moved (repoint the brief) or was removed (delete the brief). Until then the brief is authority for a file that is gone.

automatic (2):
  design-sidecar-legacy-path  [DESIGN.json]
    The design sidecar sits at DESIGN.json, a location kept only for backward compatibility.
    → Move it to .impeccable/design.json the next time the sidecar is written. No user decision is needed.
  legacy-live-state  [.impeccable-live.json]
    Live-mode state sits in retired location(s): `.impeccable-live.json`. Current live mode writes under `.impeccable/live/`.
    → These are read only through backward-compatible fallbacks and are safe to delete once no live session is running. No user decision is needed.

Applied:
  Moved DESIGN.json to .impeccable/design.json.
Left alone:
  legacy-live-state: delete by hand once no live session is running
